purpose: Machine-readable source audit for DESIGN_FREEZE decisions; not an experiment approval or MODEL_FREEZE.

evidence_classification.SPECIFIED: Value stated by the identified specification/vendor under recorded conditions.
evidence_classification.PROXY: A non-target source; proxy_subtype records whether it is measured or a published numerical case.
evidence_classification.DERIVED: Unit-consistent arithmetic from identified parent evidence.
evidence_classification.SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION: Explicit research choice, not a device fact.
evidence_classification.UNKNOWN_BLOCKING: No defensible target value/range for an absolute claim.

sources.license_or_redistribution: Document copyright/license not inferred by this audit.

Cite paper; no raw-characterization-data license inferred.

unavailable_target_parameters.bounded_option: Use separate explicit scenario components; H200 active pJ/B may bound only an aggregate high-bandwidth DRAM-link proxy, never Sandisk absolute power.
unavailable_target_parameters.claim_restriction: No absolute HBF watts, energy efficiency, or junction-temperature claim.

unavailable_target_parameters.parameter: Target HBM4 per-stack/core/PHY/refresh power versus traffic and temperature
unavailable_target_parameters.bounded_option: Use H200/HBM3E aggregate rail as generation/platform proxy with idle separate and sensitivity; calibrate allocation before per-stack results.

unavailable_target_parameters.parameter: HBF/HBM4 internal die, bond, mold/underfill, base-die, TSV, TIM, interposer, lid geometry and contact resistance
unavailable_target_parameters.bounded_option: Use OCP outer envelope as constraint; MFIT values as labeled starting proxies; sweep independently sourced material/contact intervals and validate a new reference geometry.
unavailable_target_parameters.claim_restriction: No calibrated physical package temperature until geometry/material/calibration closure.

unavailable_target_parameters.parameter: Target NAND Ea(T,PEC), RBER response, ECC capability, retry distribution, read-disturb threshold, P/E limit
unavailable_target_parameters.bounded_option: OCP deadline-only model plus HeatWatch 1.01/1.04/1.08 eV mechanism sensitivity; report traffic/conditional age rather than failure probability or years of life.
unavailable_target_parameters.claim_restriction: No Sandisk failure probability, ECC margin, or lifetime extension.

unavailable_target_parameters.parameter: Product Light/Severe/Shutdown temperature thresholds and slowdown fractions
unavailable_target_parameters.bounded_option: Keep policy thresholds as SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION strictly inside the 0-105C junction range and separate from OCP physical limits.

required_static_checks: Reject current-as-power conversions without a cited rail voltage.
Reject per-stack division of H200 aggregate memory power without an allocation model.
Require energy denominator domain: useful bytes, physical NAND bytes, or delivered link bytes.
Require MFIT-case versus target-geometry identity check.
Require kelvin and rate(Tref)=1 for Arrhenius calculations.
Mark HeatWatch use below 20C or above 70C as extrapolated.
Make Sandisk no-refresh and OCP maintenance-enabled profiles mutually exclusive.
Keep product thermal thresholds UNKNOWN until a product source exists.
Block absolute power, temperature, RBER, ECC, retry, and lifetime claims when target parameters are unavailable.
